attestations.text: Chu Ying 朱煐 (T. 臨川, H. 龍坡, d. 1774, age 76 sui), a native of Shih-p'ing, Yunnan, and a chin-shih of 1724, was so impressed by the talents of the two youths that he arranged for them to be instructed along with his own son, in a studio, Wan Hsiang T'ang 晚香堂, in the courtyard of his yamen.
